item.content:encoded:
Hi ! Thanks for the crit ! :)

So the biggest problem with the concept behind your anomaly is that it isn't actually anomalous. Human Parthenogenesis (also known as human asexual reproduction) has been proven to be a viable reproductive option for humans. This is obviously a somewhat large problem (the concept behind your anomaly isn't actually anomalous), but for now I'll crit what else is there.

Well, from my understanding all the attempts for Human Parthenogenesis have always resulted in a production of unvialable embryos (in which case the effects of my object is indeed anomalous).
In case I'm wrong, I will try to find another interesting idea.

+ show block
– hide block

This is a bit vague, but from what I'm getting this ritual will terminate another woman's pregnancy to activate the target's own pregnancy. Are there any ways of choosing which woman has their pregnancy stolen, or is it random?

It is random. To be absolutely honest, my initial draft for this idea is a bit longer, but I had to rewrite in order to not exceed the limit of 400 words.

+ show block
– hide block

Also, this brings up a logistical problem: you say that the whole concept behind this anomaly is women reproducing without men, but how is this possible in a remote African village where methods of parthenogenesis aren't available? Basically, if the ritual requires the 'stealing' of another pregnancy, and there is no way to have asexual pregnancies in the setting, then wouldn't men be needed for this ritual for initial fertilisation, thus rendering the primary theme of this concept1 null and void? ALSO also, what does 'special' mean in this context?

I mean, the whole concept of this object is that it allows a women to become pregnant. Why would they need to know about the scientific concept of Parthenogenesis ? The specific knowledge of this concept is not a requirement for the object to work. So I don't really understand your remarque here.
As for the stealing, I admit that this part is poorly developed. I will try to make it better.

Finally, the 'special' part is specified in the first line of my narrative. Basically, the children resulting from the pregnancy are what we would call "humans in great shape", but also presenting great logical thinking.

Also : I really want to develop this idea further, but I can't go beyond the 400 words limit. So I will try to be more concise in my next idea draft.

item.title: Re: Men Are Expendable
item.content:encoded:
Hey there Researcher Allied, I'll be briefly critting your idea today!
Note that I am not an official reviewer (though I am a flight officer), so take everything I say with a grain of salt. WIth that being said, let's begin the crit!

+ Open Crit +
- Close -

So the biggest problem with the concept behind your anomaly is that it isn't actually anomalous. Human Parthenogenesis (also known as human asexual reproduction) has been proven to be a viable reproductive option for humans. This is obviously a somewhat large problem (the concept behind your anomaly isn't actually anomalous), but for now I'll crit what else is there.

The SCP “steals” another woman's pregnancy in order to make the user pregnant, and children born this way might be “special”.

This is a bit vague, but from what I'm getting this ritual will terminate another woman's pregnancy to activate the target's own pregnancy. Are there any ways of choosing which woman has their pregnancy stolen, or is it random?
Also, this brings up a logistical problem: you say that the whole concept behind this anomaly is women reproducing without men, but how is this possible in a remote African village where methods of parthenogenesis aren't available? Basically, if the ritual requires the 'stealing' of another pregnancy, and there is no way to have asexual pregnancies in the setting, then wouldn't men be needed for this ritual for initial fertilisation, thus rendering the primary theme of this concept1 null and void?
ALSO also, what does 'special' mean in this context?

I'd recommend brainstorming this concept some more and altering it, because it currently suffers from some crippling logistical problems that contradict its main theme.


Anyway, that's it for my crit today. Thanks for reading, and I hope this helps!
P.S Feel free to PM me once you've revised this concept as I'll be happy to recrit this. Please link this thread in the PM though, I don't want to have to go hunting through the forums to find your post.
Footnotes
1. Men becoming obsolete due to women not requiring one for procreation.

item.title: Men Are Expendable
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight : No (not yet)

Page Type : SCP Article

Genre : Drama

Elevator Pitch : An SCP that allows a woman to get pregnant without having any sexual intercourse with a man. The activation of the SCP’s abnormal properties requires a sacrifice consisting of human blood, water and animal bones. The SCP “steals” another woman's pregnancy in order to make the user pregnant, and children born this way might be “special”.

Narrative : (( I want to use the idea of fertility and pregnancy, and put it as the central abnormal effect of this SCP. This idea is inspired by an old African legend, in which a young infertile woman, Akua, was given a doll that would supposedly help her get pregnant ; which it did, or at least according to the legend. The doll was transmitted from woman to woman, and disappeared after some time. ))

+ show block
– hide block

The Foundation received reports of a secret tribe located somewhere in Africa, in which men and women were showing incredible physical and mental abilities (strength, logical thinking and great charisma). Its inhabitants didn’t show any sign of hostility towards the SCP Agents that were sent to the place.

Upon investigating, the Foundation discovered that the tribe worshipped a wooden doll. Thanks to the efforts of The Foundation’s Translators, the agents were able to engage in a discussion with the aborigens, and discovered the abnormal effects of the doll.
The resulting births and “procreation” within the tribe were hence caused by the impact of the SCP’s abnormal effects : all of the inhabitants claimed to have a woman as their parent, and the idea of a father seemed strange to them.
It was peculiar that the tribe was so sophisticated and well-developed, despite being isolated from the rest of the world (complex language, irrigation systems…).The way it managed to remain hidden, as well as its history remains unknown.

The wooden doll was recovered [stolen] by the Foundation in order to study its anomalous properties. This led to a battle, resulting in a total termination of the tribe’s members.

Hook/Attention-Grabber : I find this SCP interesting because it deals with the subject of fertility in a curious way.
